title: [FEATURE] Add Option for Contest Organizers to Delete Contests
one_line: Asks for a way for contest organizers to delete contests they created, such as test contests.

title: [BUG] The content of the past contests "Enter" button is misaligned
one_line: The 'Enter' button in the past contests list wraps onto three lines instead of one.

title: [UI/UX] Improve Navbar: hover-effects,dropdown etc
one_line: Proposes navbar improvements: dropdowns that open on hover and the profile completion percentage shown as text.

title: [BUG] Inconsistent translations and typos across ./templates lang files
one_line: Reports Spanish text, typos and grammar errors in pt.lang and other translation files, found while working on #8717.

title: [FEATURE] GitHub Sign-In and OAuth flow
one_line: Proposes GitHub sign-in by extending the existing Google OAuth flow in Login.vue and User.php.

title: [FEATURE]dynamic problem difficulty rating based on solver ratings (ELO-inspired)
one_line: Proposes deriving problem difficulty dynamically from the ratings of the users who solve it, in the style of ELO.

title: [FEATURE] Allow printable (PDF) problem export for users with view access
one_line: Asks that the printable (PDF) problem export, currently limited to problem setters, be available to any user with view access.

title: [FEATURE] Allow hiding problem filters sidebar on collection pages
one_line: Asks for a toggle to hide the filters sidebar (tags, difficulty, quality) on problem collection pages.

title: [DOCS] Add contributor onboarding walkthrough (navigating existing setup docs)
one_line: Proposes a contributor onboarding walkthrough that guides newcomers through the existing setup docs, extending CONTRIBUTING.md.

title: [FEATURE]Simplify Test Data Setup for Problems and Contests Loading for Developers
one_line: Setting up realistic local test data is cumbersome (collections need quality_seal = 1, undocumented); proposes a simpler way to load problems and contests for developers.

title: [BUG] Safely handle localStorage failures and draft restoration in problem statement editor
one_line: The problem statement editor crashes when localStorage fails, and restored drafts are loaded into state but not shown in the Problem Creator UI.

title: [FEATURE] Allow experienced contributors to self-assign their own issues beyond max-assignment limit
one_line: Proposes letting experienced contributors self-assign issues they created beyond the five-assignment limit of the assignment bot.

title: [FEATURE]Enhance badge visuals with reusable 3D hover component
one_line: Proposes a reusable 3D hover effect component for badges on the badge list, profile and badge detail pages.

title: [UI] Pie chart tooltip in profile statistics shows verdict codes instead of full names
one_line: The pie chart tooltip in profile statistics shows verdict codes (AC, WA, TLE) instead of full verdict names.

title: [FEATURE]Improve custom test case execution for problems
one_line: Custom test case execution in the ephemeral grader is hard to find at the bottom of the problem view; proposes making it more visible and easier to use.

title: [FEATURE] friend request and user relations system
one_line: Proposes a friend request system so users can connect with and follow their peers.

title: [FEATURE] Improve Email UI and Email Flow Consistency Across omegaUp
one_line: Proposes consistent, branded transactional emails (verification, password reset, account deletion) and a review of when each is triggered.

title: [FEATURE] Save and load per-language code templates in the ephemeral grader
one_line: Proposes saving and loading a default code template per language in the ephemeral grader.

title: [FEATURE] Automatic language detection for pasted code in the ephemeral grader
one_line: Proposes detecting the programming language automatically when code is pasted into the ephemeral grader.

title: [BUG]Cypress test uses it.only() causing most E2E tests to be skipped
one_line: A stray it.only() in cypress/e2e/basic_commands.cy.ts made Cypress run 1 of 12 tests in the file and skip the other 11.

title: [BUG] External links use http:// instead of https:// in multiple Vue components
one_line: Several Vue components link to timeanddate.com, blog.omegaup.com and gravatar.com with http:// instead of https://.

title: [BUG] TA CI passes credentials via CLI arguments instead of env variables
one_line: The Teaching Assistant CI job passes passwords and API keys as plaintext command line arguments instead of environment variables.

title: [DEPRECATED] Replace deprecated @babel/polyfill with core-js v3 entry
one_line: webpack still uses the deprecated @babel/polyfill entry, which pulls in core-js 2 alongside core-js 3.

title: [BUG] Grader container fails to initialize ephemeral run manager: permission denied on /var/lib/omegaup/ephemeral
one_line: On every fresh docker compose up the grader container fails to create /var/lib/omegaup/ephemeral (permission denied), silently breaking the ephemeral run manager.

title: [BUG] No Docker healthchecks in docker-compose.yml - race condition causes intermittent startup failures
one_line: docker-compose.yml has no healthcheck blocks, so depends_on only orders container start and services race at startup.

title: [BUG] assign_badges.py get_current_owners() uses f-string SQL interpolation instead of parameterized query
one_line: assign_badges.py get_current_owners() builds its SQL with an f-string that interpolates the badge alias instead of using a parameter.

title: [BUG] db-migrate.py crashes on any command (including --help) if boto3 is not installed
one_line: stuff/db-migrate.py imports boto3 unconditionally, so every command including --help crashes when boto3 is not installed.

title: [BUG] MySQL slow_query_log is OFF in dev docker-compose — performance regressions go undetected locally
one_line: MySQL slow_query_log is off in the dev docker-compose with long_query_time at 10s, so slow queries go unnoticed locally.

title: [BUG] daily-release.yml runs weekly (Sundays) not daily — name and schedule are mismatched
one_line: The daily-release.yml workflow actually runs weekly on Sundays, a day before weekly-release.yml, and its skip conditions show as red failures.

title: [BUG] coder_of_the_month.py uses f-string SQL with dynamic problem/identity IDs - not parameterized
one_line: coder_of_the_month.py builds several queries with f-strings that interpolate problem and identity id lists instead of using parameters.

title: [BUG] build-containers.yml installs kustomize via unversioned, unchecksumed curl | bash
one_line: build-containers.yml installs kustomize by piping an unversioned, unchecksummed script from master into bash.

title: [BUG] karel.js release workflow uses end-of-life Node.js 16 and unpinned action refs
one_line: The karel.js release workflow uses end-of-life Node.js 16 and action references pinned only by tag.

title: [BUG] docker-compose.yml uses unpinned image versions for redis and rabbitmq
one_line: docker-compose.yml uses unpinned image versions for redis and rabbitmq.

title: [BUG] Dockerfile.frontend intermediate stage uses unpinned alpine:latest
one_line: Dockerfile.frontend builds an intermediate stage from alpine:latest instead of a pinned version.

title: [BUG] MySQL wait_timeout=20 and lock_wait_timeout=10 are too aggressive in dev docker-compose
one_line: MySQL wait_timeout=20 and lock_wait_timeout=10 in the dev docker-compose are short enough to drop idle connections during development.

title: [BUG] Cypress experimentalStudio and experimentalMemoryManagement flags enabled in CI config
one_line: cypress.config.ts enables experimentalStudio and experimentalMemoryManagement unconditionally, including in CI.

title: [BUG] all docker-compose services use restart: always with no failure limit — crash loops silently
one_line: All docker-compose services use restart: always with no failure limit, so a misconfigured service crash-loops silently.

title: [BUG] duplicate schools can be created for the same institution — school creation uses LIKE substring match instead of exact lookup
one_line: School creation deduplicates with a LIKE '%name%' substring match and returns the first hit, so users get attached to the wrong school or duplicates are created.

title: [BUG] filter/sort dropdown items use href="#" causing page scroll-to-top on click in contest list
one_line: Filter and sort dropdown items in ContestListv2.vue use href="#", which scrolls the page to the top on click.

title: [BUG] filter and sort-order selections are shared across all contest tabs (current / future / past)
one_line: Filter and sort selections in the contest list are one shared state for the current, future and past tabs.

title: [UX] no visual indicator on filter/sort buttons when a non-default option is active in contest list
one_line: The contest list filter and sort buttons give no visual sign that a non-default option is active.

title: [BUG] "show more contests" button causes full contest list to visually reset/reload instead of appending
one_line: Clicking 'show more contests' makes the whole contest list visibly reset and reload instead of appending new items.

title: fix: UI button and input-group alignment inconsistencies
one_line: Lists button and input-group alignment problems on the contest list and login pages, such as a gap between the reset and search buttons.

title: [BUG] isMutatingMethod() missing patterns — contest/clone and course/clone can be triggered via GET
one_line: isMutatingMethod() in ApiCaller.php misses patterns, so GET /api/contest/clone/ and GET /api/course/clone/ return 200 and create real contests and courses instead of returning 405.

title: [BUG] Clarification::apiCreate always returns null for contest_alias
one_line: Clarification::apiCreate always returns contest_alias: null because the return array hardcodes null.

title: [BUG] page parameter accepts negative values in contest/list and problem/list without returning 400
one_line: contest/list and problem/list accept a negative page parameter and treat it as page 1 instead of returning 400.

title: [BUG] User system roles lookup ignores group-based roles (GroupRoles)
one_line: User::apiExtraInformation only looks at direct UserRoles, so system roles granted through a group (GroupRoles) are not reported.

title: [BUG] user/mailingListBackfill accessible via HTTP GET
one_line: GET /api/user/mailingListBackfill/ returns 200 and runs the backfill because 'backfill' is not in the mutating patterns list; same gap as #9385.

title: [FEATURE] Show assignment deadline and overdue badge in student's AssignmentCard
one_line: Proposes showing each assignment's deadline and an overdue badge on the student's AssignmentCard, using finish_time the API already returns.

title: [FEATURE] Show per-problem solve count in contest arena Scoreboard
one_line: Proposes showing how many contestants solved each problem in the contest scoreboard header.

title: [BUG] Course arena assignment navigation shows '-' when no previous/next assignment exists
one_line: Course arena assignment navigation renders a disabled '-' button when there is no previous or next assignment.

title: [BUG] Edit button in MultiUserAddArea uses <span href="#">, invalid HTML and not keyboard accessible
one_line: The Edit control in MultiUserAddArea.vue is a <span href="#">, which is invalid HTML and not reachable by keyboard.

title: [BUG] Hardcoded strings bypass i18n in OutputOnlyDownload.vue and MultipleCasesInput.vue
one_line: OutputOnlyDownload.vue and MultipleCasesInput.vue contain hardcoded user-visible strings that bypass the translation system.

title: [FEATURE] Display API Tokens table as vertical card layout on mobile
one_line: Proposes showing the API Tokens table as stacked cards on mobile instead of a horizontally scrolling table.

title: [FEATURE] Import golden-layout CSS from node_modules instead of vendoring
one_line: Proposes importing golden-layout CSS from node_modules instead of keeping a vendored copy that can drift from the installed package.

title: [FEATURE] Modernize navbar Help menu with icon, title, and subtitle layout
one_line: Proposes a Help menu layout in the navbar where each entry has an icon, a title and a subtitle.

title: [FEATURE] Centralize entrypoint access control for lockdown mode and auth requirements
one_line: Proposes declaring each entrypoint's lockdown and authentication requirements in one central map instead of per-controller guards.

title: [BUG] arena/course.ts registers an anonymous hashchange listener with no cleanup
one_line: arena/course.ts registers an anonymous hashchange listener that can never be removed, so remounts stack listeners.

title: [FEATURE] Add cooldown period before a disabled user README can be re-enabled
one_line: Proposes a cooldown before a user README that was disabled by a report can be re-enabled by saving it again.

title: [FEATURE] Replace hand-written Rank interface in Rank.vue with auto-generated type from api_types
one_line: Proposes replacing the hand-written Rank interface in Rank.vue with the generated type from api_types.ts.

title: [FEATURE] Refactor ContestListv2 slot overrides in ContestCard to use a prop instead
one_line: Proposes replacing the slot overrides ContestListv2 uses to customize ContestCard with a dedicated prop.

title: [FEATURE] Course name search: add LIKE fallback when FULLTEXT BOOLEAN MODE returns no results
one_line: Proposed a LIKE fallback when a FULLTEXT BOOLEAN MODE course name search returns nothing.

title: [FEATURE] As a developer, I want a reusable NavbarItem component so that submenu entries are easier to maintain
one_line: Proposes extracting a reusable NavbarItem component for navbar submenu entries.

title: [FEATURE] As a contributor, I want editable fields in the feature request form so that I can fill in the As a / I want / so that prompts directly
one_line: The YAML feature request form shows the 'As a ... I want ...' user story as non-editable text; asks for editable fields.

title: [FEATURE] Refactor navbar help submenu into a reusable NavbarItem component
one_line: Proposes extracting the Help submenu markup (icon, title, description) into a reusable NavbarItem component.

title: [FEATURE] Add unit test infrastructure for cron scripts
one_line: The cron scripts in stuff/cron have almost no Python unit tests; proposes shared test infrastructure (mock cursor and connection, fixtures) and first tests.

title: [FEATURE] Add unit tests for update_ranks.py ranking logic
one_line: Proposes unit tests for the pure ranking logic in update_ranks.py, the largest cron script, which had none.

title: [FEATURE] Add unit tests for assign_badges.py
one_line: Proposes unit tests for assign_badges.py and fixing how get_all_owners substitutes the timestamp into the SQL text.

title: [FEATURE] Add a generic "View unavailable" component
one_line: Proposes one reusable 'View unavailable' component for views that an admin has turned off, driven by a server flag.

title: [FEATURE] Parameterize string-built queries in coder_of_the_month.py
one_line: Queries in coder_of_the_month.py paste values, including user-controlled usernames, into SQL strings; proposes parameterizing them.

title: [FEATURE] Avoid full delete and reinsert of User_Rank in update_ranks
one_line: update_user_rank deletes and reinserts the whole User_Rank table every run; proposes writing only what changed.

title: [FEATURE] Prevent and merge duplicate school profiles
one_line: Schools are created implicitly from free text in the profile, so duplicates keep appearing; proposes preventing new duplicates and merging existing ones.

title: [FEATURE] Emit structured per-phase logs from cron scripts
one_line: Cron scripts log their per-phase counts only inside message strings; proposes emitting them as structured fields as well.

title: [FEATURE] Replace acl_id/role_id magic numbers in cron scripts with named constants
one_line: Cron queries hardcode acl_id = 1 and role_id = 1; proposes named constants in a shared stuff/cron/constants.py.

title: duplicate
one_line: Empty issue opened by mistake and titled 'duplicate'.

title: [FEATURE] Extend the navbar item style with icons and descriptions to remaining submenus
one_line: Proposes extending the new navbar item style (icon, title, description) to the Contests, Courses, Problems and Ranking submenus.

title: [FEATURE] Build the navbar menus from a single configuration with visibility rules
one_line: Proposes building all navbar menus from one configuration with per-entry visibility rules instead of v-if conditions in the template.

title: [FEATURE] Cron Control Plane : an observability and operational tooling for background jobs
one_line: Epic for the Cron Control Plane: run history, overlap protection, an admin health view, freshness signals and safe reruns for background jobs.

title: [FEATURE] persistant cron execution history by registry and run tables
one_line: Adds a cron job registry table and an execution history table so each run is recorded.

title: [FEATURE] DAOs for the cron tables
one_line: Adds generated and handwritten DAOs for the cron tables.

title: [FEATURE] Reusable cron runner that records runs and prevents overlap
one_line: Adds a shared cron runner that records each run and its phases and takes a MySQL advisory lock so two runs of the same job cannot overlap.

title: [FEATURE] Admin API for cron run history and health
one_line: Adds admin-only API endpoints for the cron job list, recent runs and one run's per-phase detail.

title: [FEATURE] Record update_ranks executions through the runner
one_line: Wraps update_ranks in the shared runner so its runs are recorded and cannot overlap.

title: [FEATURE] Admin dashboard page for cron jobs
one_line: Adds an admin page at /admin/crons showing each job's latest status, recent runs, per-phase timings and errors.

title: [FEATURE] Record assign_badges and aggregate_feedback through the runner
one_line: Adopts the runner in assign_badges and aggregate_feedback, and makes assign_badges report failure when any single badge fails.

title: [FEATURE] Pre-publish guardrail for the ranking job
one_line: Adds an in-transaction audit that rolls back the ranking job if the new ranking is empty, has negative scores or drops too many users.

title: [FEATURE] Make the view unavailable entrypoint generic and driven by the payload
one_line: Proposes making the grader-specific 'view unavailable' entrypoint generic and driven by the server payload.

title: [FEATURE] Let admins safely rerun a cron job
one_line: Proposes an admin action that queues a cron rerun request for a trusted worker to execute, instead of needing shell access to a pod.

title: [FEATURE] Record the remaining crons through the runner
one_line: Adopts the runner in the on-demand jobs build_problem_rec_model and plagiarism_detector.

title: [FEATURE] End to end test for the cron dashboard
one_line: Proposes a Cypress end-to-end test for the cron dashboard and the rerun action.

title: [FEATURE] Improve the cron dashboard with health cards, filters, relative times and auto refresh
one_line: Proposes cron dashboard improvements: health cards per job, filters, relative times and auto refresh.

title: [FEATURE] Make the recommendation model training scheduled, recorded and guarded
one_line: Proposes making recommendation model training a scheduled job that records each run's quality and refuses to publish a model that is below a floor or worse than the last published one.

title: [FEATURE] Detect problems that silently stopped working
one_line: Proposes a nightly job that detects problems that stopped working (judge errors, no languages, never solved, deprecated but public) and lists them for admins.
